bagPolicy.summary: You can bring a small personal item such as a purse. Oversized purses, cinch bags, sling bags and other oversized bags are not allowed.
allowed: Small personal item such as a purse
bagPolicy.quote: Patrons are allowed to attend with a small personal item such as a purse.

parking.summary: Free parking is available throughout Old Town Fort Collins around the theatre.
parking.quote: Ample free parking is located throughout Old Town Fort Collins.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Aggie Theatre. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Outside food and drink are not allowed, including outside alcohol, cans and glass containers. Sealed water bottles are not allowed, but you can bring an empty water bottle without its lid.
allowed: Empty water bottle without the lid
concessions.quote: Outside food and drink are not allowed.

accessibility.summary: For reserved seat shows, look for the designated accessible tickets when you buy online. For general admission shows, buy your ticket first, then email boxoffice@z2ent.com to arrange seating.
accessibility.quote: If you wish to attend a reserved seated show, please look for our designated accessible tickets when purchasing online.

reEntry.summary: Aggie Theatre hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Buy tickets through AXS.com or TIXR.com, since tickets from other sellers can't be validated, and show your ticket in the TIXR app because screenshots are not accepted. Shows are all ages unless stated, children 15 and under need an adult, and only current state-issued IDs and passports are accepted for age-restricted shows.
ticketPickup.quote: Yes, as long as you are using your TIXR Mobile App. We cannot accept screenshots of tickets.

gates.summary: Aggie Theatre hasn't published entry and door details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
